name: Mera Superpower
author: Richa Sharma
headline: Every child has a superpower. Some just learn differently.
hindi_line: हर बच्चे में एक सुपरपावर है।
intro: I'm Richa, a teacher who returned to the classroom. I write about learning, help children who think differently find their footing, and help their parents along the way.
about: I started my career teaching young children at Bal Bharati Public School in Delhi. Those years taught me something I never forgot: the child who struggles in class is rarely the child who isn't trying.
An MBA took me into the corporate world, leading sales and marketing at Cafe Coffee Day and Times Internet. I learned how to listen to people, explain things clearly and build something from scratch.
Now I'm bringing both together. I work with children who learn differently, including those with ADHD, dyslexia and other learning differences, and with the parents and teachers around them.

services.title: For children
services.text: Patient, one-on-one learning support that builds on what a child is good at, not just what they find hard.

services.title: For parents
services.text: Practical guidance on understanding a diagnosis, working with schools and supporting learning at home.

services.title: For schools
services.text: Workshops that help teachers spot learning differences early and adapt their classrooms.
